title: STOKES: “DON’T PUT WORDS IN MY MOUTH, PLEASE!”  England beat New Zealand by 115 runs
quote_text:
Post-match press conference with England captain Ben Stokes after England’s 115-run victory over New Zealand in the first Rothesay Test at Lord’s.

England made 140 and 226, while New Zealand were bowled out for 113 and 138 after being set 254 to win.

Emilio Gay made a crucial 57 on his Test debut, Harry Brook hit 56 in the first innings, Ollie Robinson was named Player of the Match after taking 7-77 on his England return, and Gus Atkinson finished the chase with 5-30.

Stokes reflects on the difficult Lord’s pitch, why the extreme conditions were not ideal for Test cricket, England’s quick read of the surface, Robinson’s comeback, Gay’s debut contribution, and why the squad must move on quickly with five Tests still to come.
